User Story: As a user, I want to securely sign in so I can access my tickets.
Tasks: Registration and login; password reset; role-based access; session management

User Story: As a customer, I want to submit a support ticket so I can request assistance.
Tasks: Create submission form; add categories and priorities; support attachments; validate fields

User Story: As an agent, I want to update tickets so their progress is accurately tracked.
Tasks: Add status transitions; edit details; record history; add internal notes

User Story: As a manager, I want to assign tickets to agents so work is distributed effectively.
Tasks: Manual assignment; automatic assignment rules; reassignment; workload view

User Story: As an agent, I want to find relevant tickets quickly so I can respond efficiently.
Tasks: Keyword search; filters; sorting and pagination; saved searches

User Story: As a customer, I want to communicate with agents within my ticket.
Tasks: Threaded comments; reply attachments; public and internal replies; author timestamps

User Story: As a user, I want notifications about ticket changes so I remain informed.
Tasks: Email notifications; in-app notifications; user preferences; event triggers

User Story: As a manager, I want SLA tracking so tickets are resolved within agreed timelines.
Tasks: Configure policies; calculate deadlines; display warnings; escalate breaches

User Story: As a manager, I want support metrics so I can evaluate team performance.
Tasks: Create dashboards; track response and resolution times; report ticket volumes; export CSV

User Story: As a customer, I want to find answers before opening a ticket so I can resolve common issues independently.
Tasks: Manage articles; add search and categories; suggest articles; collect usefulness ratings
